title: Crystal-structure design by agentic AI in a language of motifs
abstract: arXiv:2608.15900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data-driven materials discovery interpolates more reliably than it extrapolates and seldom reaches new structure types. We present MatEvolve, an agentic-AI framework designing crystals, proposing each candidate with a stated rationale and testing it. The agent reasons in an interpretable \emph{language of motifs}, writing each crystal as a \emph{motif profile} that describes the recurring geometric patterns---the \emph{motifs}---composing it. The motif profile serves not merely as a description of a material but as the medium for material design: the agent edits the profile and constructs a crystal from the modified one, and the most promising candidates are validated by first-principles calculation. Applied to the design of rare-earth-lean permanent magnets, MatEvolve---built on the state-of-the-art language model Claude Fable~5 without fine-tuning---reaches new structural prototypes more than three times as often as generative models

translated_title: 基于基元语言的主体智能体晶体结构设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15900v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：数据驱动的材料发现以内插方式比外推方式更可靠，且很少能达到新的结构类型。我们提出了MatEvolve，一个主体智能体AI框架，用于设计晶体，每个候选方案都附带明确的理由并进行测试。该智能体以可解释的“基元语言”进行推理，将每个晶体写成“基元轮廓”，描述构成晶体的重复几何模式——即“基元”。基元轮廓不仅作为材料的描述，还作为材料设计的媒介：智能体编辑轮廓并根据修改后的轮廓构建晶体，最有前景的候选方案通过第一性原理计算进行验证。应用于稀土稀缺永磁体的设计，MatEvolve——基于最先进的语言模型Claude Fable 5，无需微调——达到新结构原型的频率是生成模型的3倍以上。
tldr: MatEvolve利用可解释的基元语言和主体智能体，无需微调即达到新结构原型，比生成模型高出三倍以上，显著提升材料设计的外推能力。
en_tdlr: MatEvolve leverages an interpretable motif language and agentic AI, achieving new structural prototypes over three times more often than generative models without fine-tuning, significantly enhancing extrapolation in materials design.
